columns.heading: US Size
columns.explain: is the US dress size each letter size corresponds to on this blank. It is a guide to the cut, not a measurement of the garment. If it disagrees with the bust column, trust the bust column.

columns.heading: Bust (laid flat)
columns.how: Across the front, seam to seam, about an inch below the armhole, with the vest laid flat.
columns.explain: is the garment's width measured across the front only, from one side seam to the other, about an inch below the armhole. To replicate on a vest you own, lay it flat and measure straight across at that point, with the zip closed. This is a contoured women's cut, so it is shaped through the waist below this point.

columns.heading: Fits Chest
columns.explain: is your own body measurement, not the garment. Wrap a soft tape around the fullest part of your chest, parallel to the floor, snug but not tight. If your chest falls inside a size's range, that size fits with room to layer over a base layer.

columns.heading: Body Length
columns.how: From the highest point of the shoulder straight down to the finished hem at the back.
columns.explain: is measured from the highest point of the shoulder straight down to the finished hem at the back. To replicate, lay the garment flat and measure vertically from that shoulder point to the lowest edge of the hem.

how_to.heading: How to Find Your Perfect Fit
how_to.note: Every measurement in this guide is of the garment laid flat, except Fits Chest, which is your body.

steps.title: Grab a layer you love
steps.detail: A vest or light jacket that fits how you want. Lay it flat.

steps.title: Measure and compare
steps.detail: Match it to the chart below. Bust decides your size.

steps.title: Pick your size
steps.detail: Between two? Size up for a relaxed layering fit, or down for a closer one.

footer: Measurements are of the garment laid flat. A manufacturing tolerance of ±1 inch applies to all measurements.
